user.title: Choose local connection
user.description: Bluetooth connects for every poll. Wi-Fi runs a TLS WebSocket server in Home Assistant and uses Bluetooth once to point the CATCH at it.

bluetooth_device.title: Connect over Bluetooth
bluetooth_device.description: Close Configurator on your phone. A password is optional for monitoring and required for schedule changes.

wifi.title: Connect over local Wi-Fi
wifi.description: Home Assistant will create and retain a long-lived RSA certificate, listen on the selected port, and configure both device server slots over authenticated Bluetooth. The advertised host must resolve to this Home Assistant system from the device VLAN.

init.description: Wi-Fi endpoint changes are authenticated and applied over Bluetooth during reload. Times use the device clock.
